name: no-more-caffeine
title: No More Caffeine
description: Log caffeine intake, estimate the caffeine left in your body, and see whether more coffee is likely to disturb your sleep.
author: atsushi_kawamura

commands.name: log-caffeine
commands.title: Log Caffeine
commands.description: Log a caffeine intake and see predicted residual levels

commands.name: todays-caffeine
commands.title: Today's Caffeine
commands.description: View intake history and current residual caffeine levels

commands.name: caffeine-timeline
commands.title: Caffeine Timeline
commands.description: See a 24-hour caffeine curve and an estimated last-cup cutoff

commands.name: what-if
commands.title: What If
commands.description: Preview how adding a drink could change estimated caffeine at bedtime

commands.name: quick-log
commands.title: Quick Log Caffeine
commands.description: Log a preset or favorite drink with one action

commands.name: caffeine-history
commands.title: Caffeine History
commands.description: View daily, weekly, and monthly caffeine charts and transfer intake history

commands.name: caffeine-settings
commands.title: Caffeine Settings
commands.description: Configure bedtime, half-life, thresholds, and custom drinks

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Caffeine Status
commands.description: Show current caffeine status in menu bar

tools.name: get-caffeine-status
tools.title: Get Caffeine Status
tools.description: Read today’s logged caffeine, estimated caffeine remaining now and at bedtime, and the configured limits

tools.name: preview-caffeine
tools.title: Preview Caffeine and Last Cup by
tools.description: Estimate how a hypothetical drink would affect bedtime caffeine and calculate its last-cup cutoff without logging it

tools.name: get-caffeine-history
tools.title: Get Caffeine History
tools.description: Read daily, weekly, or monthly caffeine totals, trends, and optional individual intake entries

tools.name: list-caffeine-drinks
tools.title: List Caffeine Drinks
tools.description: Find built-in and custom drink presets, favorite drinks, serving sizes, and estimated caffeine amounts

tools.name: log-caffeine-intake
tools.title: Log Caffeine Intake
tools.description: Add a drink already consumed to caffeine history, using a preset, serving size, or stated caffeine amount

preferences.name: bedtime
preferences.title: Bedtime
preferences.description: Your usual bedtime in HH:mm format (e.g., 22:00)

preferences.name: halfLife
preferences.title: Caffeine Half-Life (hours)
preferences.description: How many hours it takes for half the caffeine to be eliminated (default: 5)

preferences.name: maxCaffeineAtBedtime
preferences.title: Max Residual Caffeine at Bedtime (mg)
preferences.description: Maximum allowed residual caffeine at bedtime (default: 50 mg)

preferences.name: dailyMaxCaffeine
preferences.title: Daily Max Caffeine (mg)
preferences.description: Optional: Maximum total caffeine intake per day (average: 200-400 mg)
